transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Name]. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I'm... well, I was told to come in. It's just... work stuff. Dispatch and compliance, they've been... tracking my route changes. Through the computer system. And making these little comments on the radio. People keep saying it's just normal oversight, but... I know certain drivers are reporting on me.
Do you believe that people are deliberately targeting you or spying on you outside of work as well, or is this something that only happens while you're at work?

I... I don't really know about outside. I'm just talking about my job. Like I already said, it's... it's the computer system. Compliance tracking my routes, and... the things they say on the radio. I just know for a fact the other drivers are reporting on me. That's all. I don't really want to talk about my time off.
Have you ever felt like people are watching you or talking about you when you're not at work, or that events happening around you have a special meaning specifically for you?
I... I don't think so. Not really. I just... I go home, I stay in. I don't really pay attention to what's happening outside of my shift. I just want to do my job and be left alone.
Have you ever had thoughts that people not related to your job were watching you, following you, or talking about you?
No. Like I said... I just go home. I don't really see anyone else. I don't know why you keep asking about outside of work.
Have you ever had any experiences where you felt that something was trying to communicate with you in a special way, like through TV, music, or other everyday events?
No. I don't... I don't really know what you mean by that. I just watch normal shows sometimes. It's just TV. Nothing like that.
Have you ever felt that things people say or do, even if not directed at you, were actually meant for you or had a hidden meaning for you personally?
No. I... I don't think so. People just say things, you know? It doesn't have anything to do with me. I just try to keep my head down.
Do you ever feel that the tracking or comments from compliance, or the reports from other drivers, are part of a larger plan or conspiracy against you?
No. I mean... it's just my job. They track the trucks, that's what they do. It's not a conspiracy, it's just... compliance. I don't know why you're trying to make it sound like something else.
Do you believe that the tracking by compliance or the reports from other drivers are based on something that isn't actually happening, or do you feel it's all based on real events?

It's... it's real. I mean, that's why I'm even here. Dispatch and compliance... they've been tracking my route changes. Through the computer system. And... there are little comments on the radio. 

Even when people say it's just normal oversight, I... I can tell. I can tell certain drivers are reporting on me. I just know they are.
Have you ever had any beliefs or suspicions that others do not share, even when there was no clear evidence to support them?

I... I just told you about that. The tracking. People at work... they don't believe me, I guess. They say it's just normal oversight. They tell me there's no proof that the other drivers are reporting on me, or that the radio comments mean anything. 

But I know what I see on the computer system. I can just tell. I don't... I don't really know what else you want me to say about it.

Even though others have told you there's no proof that the other drivers are reporting on you or that the radio comments are about you, do you still believe it completely, even if there's no evidence they can see?

Yeah. I still believe it. I mean... I know what's happening. The tracking on the computer, the route changes... the things they say on the radio. It doesn't matter if they can't see it or if they say it's just oversight. I can tell they're reporting on me. That's... that's why I'm here.
Even though others have not seen any proof that drivers are reporting on you, do you still hold your belief so strongly that you feel certain it's true, no matter what others say?

Yes. I... I feel like I keep saying the same thing. I know what dispatch is doing with the route changes on the computer. I hear the radio. It doesn't matter if other people call it oversight... I know the other drivers are reporting on me. That's just how it is.

Even though no one else has confirmed that the other drivers are reporting on you, do you still feel like it's an undeniable fact, and that anyone who doesn't see it is just ignoring or refusing to acknowledge the truth?

Yeah. I mean... yes. It's a fact. Dispatch and compliance are tracking my route changes on the computer. The little comments on the radio... I know certain drivers are reporting on me. Even if people say it's just normal oversight, or they ignore it... I know it's happening. I just... I don't really want to keep repeating myself.
Even though there's no clear evidence that other drivers are reporting on you, do you still believe it so strongly that you feel it's the only explanation that makes sense?

Yes. Like I just said... it's the only thing that makes sense. I'm here because dispatch and compliance are tracking me. The radio, the route changes on the computer... even if people say it's just oversight, I know those drivers are reporting on me. I... I really don't have anything else to add to that. I already answered this.
